test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.**

Information, especially of a biased or misleading nature, used to promote a political cause or point of view
solution: The correct answer is** "Propaganda."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Propaganda"** means information, especially of a biased or misleading nature, used to promote a political cause or point of view. ((राजनीतिक नेता, दल आदि के लिए समर्थन जुटाने में प्रयुक्त) असत्‍य या अतिशयोक्तिपूर्ण जानकारी और विचार; मतप्रचार, दुष्‍प्रचार) • **Example**: *At school we were fed communist/right-wing **propaganda**__.* • It is derived from the Latin word** 'propagare' **which means to propagate or spread. • The correct answer is option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Welter** means a large number of items in no order or confusion. (बिना किसी क्रम या भ्रम के बड़ी संख्या में आइटम) • **Potable** means fit for drinking. ((पानी) पीने के लिए सुरक्षित) • **Orchard** means a piece of land planted with fruit trees. (फलों का बाग़, फलोद्यान) 1bc:T6df, Here, the erroneous part is **"everyone were up and buzzing."**
